profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Hi! I’m a software engineer based in Boston, with experience building large-scale, production systems across web and games. My background is strongest in frontend and product-focused engineering, with a focus on JavaScript/TypeScript, modern UI architecture, and performance-sensitive systems.

I’ve shipped features for Riot Games’ Teamfight Tactics and have worked across the stack, from frontend clients to backend services and engine-level code. I value end-to-end ownership and enjoy collaborating closely with design and product partners to bring ideas from concept to production.

My approach to software is human-centered; I care about accessibility, usability, and building systems that are reliable, maintainable, and pleasant to use.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed features for Riot Games’ live-service game Teamfight Tactics across PC and mobile clients
    • Supported bi-weekly patches and bi-annual set releases to over 33 million global players
    • Added functionality to the around-game Team Planner such as supporting multiple teams and sets to boost retention
    • Provided subject matter expertise for developing the Chromium PC client with Ember.js
    • Implemented mobile and in-game features in a proprietary C++-based engine to maintain parity between platforms
    • Guided a team of artists as the sole engineer to implement a mobile home page redesign
• Created internal prototypes in Unity and Unreal Engine for client pitches and proofs of concept
positions.insights: Skills: Unity · HTML · JavaScript · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Unreal Engine · Frontend Architecture · Unreal Engine 4 · Ember.js · C++ · C#

positions.title: Front-End Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Developed educational digital portfolio features with React and Redux including feed posts,
assignment assessment, and curriculum tags
• Researched and implemented accessibility practices such as WAI-ARIA to meet WCAG 2 AA accessibility standards
• Performed intensive multi-platform regression testing and bug reporting for QA
positions.insights: Skills: Web Development · React.js · HTML · Accessibility · JavaScript · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · WAI-ARIA · Jest · TypeScript · Frontend Architecture · React

positions.title: React Game Developer
positions.description:
• Created cognitive assessment games with React for researchers and study participants
• Designed and implemented UI for the video calling feature of an exercise application for the elderly
• Created mock designs for an admin dashboard to monitor exercise application usage and statistics
positions.insights: Skills: Graphic Design · Web Development · User Interface Design · React.js · Web Design · TypeScript · React

positions.title: Broadcast Engineering and Systems Technology Intern
positions.description:
• Provided tech support across divisions of CNN such as newsgathering and broadcasting
• Presented design adjustments to improve visibility of podcast features on news site
